summary: A 2022 teaser for the debut single, and the comments are almost purely anticipation. Every high-liked comment is a variant of 'this is only a teaser and it already sounds like a hit', with viewers noting goosebumps from a few seconds of audio and repeatedly promising to farm views on release day. A second thread is surprise at how sweet and clean the vocals sound, from an audience that had only heard these three talk on camera. A smaller cluster references the long wait — they remember Goy saying a song was coming and say the teaser proves she delivered. There is no criticism and no requests beyond wanting the full release, which makes this a clean read on how a teaser should behave: it converts curiosity into a scheduled appointment.
